teaser.en: People once wore this tree: its bark was beaten into cloth, which is how it earned one of its Digo names.
teaser.sw: Zamani watu waliuvaa mti huu: gome lake lilipigwa likawa nguo, na hivyo ndivyo lilivyopata mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo.

summary.en: *Mgua* is a tall forest tree with pale ringed bark that drips cream latex, found in the moist forest remnants of Shimba Hills and the kayas. Its bark was once beaten into barkcloth for clothing, and its soft wood still goes into veneer and canoes.
summary.sw: *Mgua*, au mkunde, ni mti mrefu wa msituni wenye gome jeupe-jeupe lenye pete linalotiririsha utomvu wa rangi ya krimu, unaopatikana katika mabaki ya misitu yenye unyevu ya Shimba Hills na kaya. Zamani gome lake lilipigwa kutengeneza nguo za gome, na mti wake laini bado hutumika kwa mbao nyembamba za kubandika (veneer) na mitumbwi.

about.en:
*Mgua* can reach 40 metres, rising into the forest canopy. Its bark is smooth, pale grey and marked with rings, and a cut releases a creamy latex. The branchlets droop, and the leaves are rough and papery. The fruits are small, red and velvety.

From a distance it can be mistaken for the prized *mvure* (mvule), which is why carpenters call it 'false mvule'.
about.sw:
*Mgua* unaweza kufikia mita 40, ukipanda hadi kilele cha msitu. Gome lake ni laini, la kijivu hafifu na lenye alama za pete, na likikatwa hutoa utomvu wa rangi ya krimu. Vitawi vyake huinama, na majani yake ni machakavu na membamba kama karatasi. Matunda yake ni madogo, mekundu na laini kama mahameli.

Ukiwa mbali unaweza kudhaniwa kuwa ni *mvure* (mvule) unaothaminiwa sana, na ndiyo sababu maseremala huuita 'false mvule', yaani mvule bandia.

where.en: This is a tree of moist forest. On the south coast it survives in forest remnants such as the Shimba Hills and the kaya forests; it also grows at Gede to the north. Look for its pale, ringed trunk among the big trees of the canopy.
where.sw: Huu ni mti wa msitu wenye unyevu. Katika pwani ya kusini umesalia katika mabaki ya misitu kama Shimba Hills na misitu ya kaya; pia hukua Gede upande wa kaskazini. Tafuta shina lake jeupe-jeupe lenye pete miongoni mwa miti mikubwa ya kilele cha msitu.

uses.en:
In the past the bark was stripped and beaten into barkcloth, which was worn as clothing.

Today the wood is used as soft timber, for veneer and for canoes. It is not durable, which is what separates it from *mvure* in a carpenter's eyes. The leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Zamani gome lilibambuliwa na kupigwa kutengeneza nguo za gome, zilizovaliwa kama mavazi.

Leo mti wake hutumika kama mbao laini, kwa mbao nyembamba za kubandika (veneer) na kwa mitumbwi. Haudumu muda mrefu, na hilo ndilo linaloutofautisha na *mvure* machoni mwa seremala. Majani na mizizi hutumika katika dawa za jadi.

culture.en: Both Digo names tell its story. *Mgua* means 'peeling', from the way the bark comes away. *Mnguonguo* comes from *nguo*, 'cloth', because the bark was once made into clothes.
culture.sw: Majina yote mawili ya Kidigo yanasimulia hadithi yake. *Mgua* maana yake ni 'unaobambuka', kutokana na jinsi gome linavyotoka. *Mnguonguo* linatokana na *nguo*, kwa sababu zamani gome lake lilitengenezwa kuwa mavazi.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mgua* and *mnguonguo*; the ICRAF handbook gives *mnguonguo*, which is also the Giriama name. In Swahili it is *mkunde*. In English it is called false mvule or antiaris. Carpenters use 'false *mvure*' to set it apart from the true *mvure*, *Milicia excelsa*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mgua* na *mnguonguo*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *mnguonguo*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kigiriama. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkunde*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *false mvule* au *antiaris*. Maseremala hutumia 'false *mvure*' kuutofautisha na *mvure* halisi, *Milicia excelsa*.

reason.en: The true mvule it is mistaken for

reason.sw: Jamaa wa familia ya mitini mwenye utomvu kama maziwa

reason.en: Small latex-bearing relative in the same family
reason.sw: Jamaa mdogo wa familia moja mwenye utomvu

reason.en: Another light wood used for boats
reason.sw: Mti mwingine mwepesi unaotumika kwa mashua
